# Assignment 1: Create a Quarto Website

## Website Development

This personal website was created using RStudio and Quarto for EPPS 6302: Methods of Data Collection and Production at The University of Texas at Dallas. The website serves as an academic portfolio presenting my academic background, curriculum vitae, research, teaching experience, and course assignments. Quarto provides a flexible framework for integrating text, R code, tables, and figures into web pages.

## Design and Layout

The website uses a minimalist design with custom CSS, a white background, dark text, and the Inter font to create a clean and professional appearance. The homepage features a personal photograph, academic biography, research interests, and contact information. Blue hyperlinks distinguish external resources from regular text. The responsive layout improves readability across desktop and mobile devices.

## Navigation and Functionality

The navigation bar includes five sections: Home, CV, Research, Teaching, and Assignments. The CV section provides access to my updated curriculum vitae in PDF format. The Research and Teaching sections present my academic work and teaching experience. The Assignments dropdown menu provides direct access to all eight course assignments.

Each assignment is organized in a separate Quarto document, allowing code, data analysis, tables, figures, and written interpretations to be presented together. The website is published through GitHub Pages, providing an accessible platform for presenting coursework and documenting reproducible research.

:::
